npc.dorian.hm_well_we_14: Hm. Well, we could use some fresh blood. Ahum. Do you want to join the thieves guild, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.dorian.yes_i_sell_15: Yes, I sell lock picks. Ask me for a trade.
npc.doubleday.very_nice_there_1: Very nice, there you go! Just bring me the printout from the probe after deploying it! You can request a new probing {device} or a new {detector} if you lose it - but it takes some time for me to get a new one ready so be careful with that stuff.
npc.doubleday.hey_lets_try_2: Hey, let's try to be reasonable here, alright? That's a bit too much for what you did, isn't it? It may seem that way but the number of votes I can offer isn't limitless.
npc.doubleday.good_you_just_3: Good, you just gained 1 genuine votes in the magistrate!
npc.doubleday.alright_there_you_4: Alright, there you go - please, try to be more careful with my equipment next time!
npc.doubleday.well_lets_see_5: Well, let's see, you helped me 1 times before exchanging any votes - how many votes do you want me to give you in exchange?
npc.doubleday.well_lets_see_6: Well, let's see, you helped me 1 times before exchanging any votes - how many votes do you want me to give you in {exchange}?
npc.doubleday.alright_then_thats_7: Alright then, that's 2 vote(s) you want - I won't take them back, are you sure?
npc.doubleday.alright_then_thats_8: Alright then, that's 1 vote(s) you want - I won't take them back, are you sure?
npc.doubleday.you_must_wait_9: You must wait until the detector is ready again.
npc.dove.oh_no_i_1: Oh no! I knew that day would come! I am slightly above the allowed weight and if you can't supply me with some grapes to slim down I will get fired. Do you happen to have some grapes with you?
npc.dove.oh_thank_you_2: Oh thank you! Thank you so much! So listen ... <whispers her measurements>
npc.dukosch.do_you_want_1: Do you want to purchase a weekly ticket for the ore wagons? With it you can travel freely and swiftly through Kazordoon for one week. 250 gold only. Deal?
npc.dukosch.your_weekly_ticket_2: Your weekly ticket is still valid. Would be a waste of money to purchase a second one
npc.dukosch.here_is_your_3: Here is your stamp. It can't be transferred to another person and will last one week from now. You'll get notified upon using an ore wagon when it isn't valid anymore.
npc.duncan.youre_talking_about_1: You're talking about my sabre? Well, even though you earned our trust, you'd have to fulfill a task first before you are granted to wear such a sabre.
npc.duncan.i_need_a_2: I need a new quality atlas for our captains. Only one of the best will do it. I heard the explorers society sells the best, but only to members of a certain rank. You will have to get this rank or ask a high ranking member to buy it for you.
npc.duncan.did_you_get_3: Did you get an atlas of the explorers society as I requested?
npc.duncan.you_did_some_4: You did some impressive things. I think people here start considering you as one of us. But these are dire times and everyone of us is expected to give his best and even exceed himself. Do you think you can handle that?
npc.duncan.did_you_rescue_5: Did you rescue one of those poor soon-to-be baby tortoises from Nargor?
npc.duncan.are_you_up_6: Are you up to the task which I'm going to give you and willing to prove you're worthy of wearing such a sabre?
npc.duncan.good_come_back_10: Good! Come back to me once you have gathered 100 eye patches.
npc.duncan.good_job_alright_11: Good job. Alright, now bring me 100 peg legs.
npc.duncan.nice_lastly_bring_13: Nice. Lastly, bring me 100 pirate hooks. That should be enough to earn your sabre.
npc.duncan.i_see_i_15: I see, I see. Well done. Go to Morgan and tell him this codeword: 'firebird'. He'll know what to do.
npc.duncan.indeed_what_a_17: Indeed, what a fine work... the book I mean. Your work was acceptable all in all.
npc.duncan.a_real_tortoise_19: A real tortoise egg ... I guess you are more accustomed to rescue some noblewoman in distress but you did something goodtoday.
npc.elane.oh_my_winged_1: Oh, my winged tiara? Those are traditionally awarded after having completed a difficult {task} for our guild, only to female aspirants though. Male warriors will receive a hooded cloak.
npc.elane.so_you_are_2: So you are saying that you would like to prove that you deserve to wear such a hooded cloak?
npc.elane.im_so_excited_3: I'm so excited! Have you really found my crossbow?
npc.elane.did_you_bring_4: Did you bring me 100 pieces of lizard leather and 100 pieces of red dragon leather?
npc.elane.were_you_able_5: Were you able to get hold of 5 enchanted chicken wings?
npc.elane.ah_have_you_6: Ah, have you brought one piece of royal steel, draconian steel and hell steel each?
npc.elane.thats_the_spirit_7: That's the spirit! I hope you will find my crossbow, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.elane.yeah_i_could_8: Yeah! I could kiss you right here and there! Besides, you're a handsome one. <giggles> Please bring me 100 pieces of lizard leather and 100 pieces of red dragon leather now!
npc.elane.good_work_playername_10: Good work, |PLAYERNAME|! That is enough leather for a lot of sturdy quivers. Now, please bring me 5 enchanted chicken wings.
npc.elane.great_now_we_12: Great! Now we can create a few more Tiaras. If only they weren't that expensive... Well anyway, please obtain one piece of royal steel, draconian steel and hell steel each.
npc.elane.wow_im_impressed_14: Wow, I'm impressed, |PLAYERNAME|. Your really are a valuable member of our paladin guild. I shall grant you your reward now. Wear it proudly!
npc.elathriel.come_back_when_2: Come back when you have enough money.
npc.elathriel.believe_me_its_3: Believe me, it's better for you that way.
npc.eleonore.oh_my_beloved_1: Oh, my beloved ring! Have you found it and want to return it to me?
npc.eleonore.i_would_need_2: I would need some help in another matter. It is only a small errand. Are you interested?
npc.eleonore.great_thank_you_3: Great, thank you! As promised, here are your 5 gold pieces. Is there ... anything left that you might want to discuss with me?
npc.eleonore.you_have_returned_4: You have returned my ring and proven yourself as trustworthy. There is something I have to discuss with you. Are you willing to listen?
npc.eleonore.blushes_oh_he_5: <blushes> Oh, he is so wonderful. A very special man with a special place in my heart.
npc.eleonore.i_cant_thank_6: I can't thank you enough for freeing my beloved Ray from that evil spell. I am still shocked that a mermaid could steal his love that easily.
npc.eleonore.oh_thank_you_7: Oh, thank you so much! Take this gold as a reward. ... which reminds me, I would need some help in another matter. It is only a small errand. Are you interested?
npc.eleonore.thank_you_it_8: Thank you! It is not a difficult matter but a rather urgent one. I need to send some money to a person in town. Would you be willing to run this small errand for me?
npc.eleonore.i_was_hoping_9: I was hoping that you'd agree. Please deliver these 200 gold pieces to the herbalist Charlotta in the south-western part of the town. If you return from this errand, I will grant you 5 gold pieces as reward for your efforts.
npc.elliott.im_glad_to_1: I'm glad to see you back alive and healthy. Did you find anything interesting that you want to {report}?
npc.elliott.the_sewers_need_2: The sewers need repair. You in?
npc.elliott.elliotts_keeps_calling_3: Elliott's keeps calling it that. It's just another job! You fixed some broken pipes and stuff? Let me check, {ok}?
npc.elliott.good_broken_pipe_4: Good. Broken pipe and generator pieces, there's smoke evading. That's how you recognise them. See how you can fix them using your hands. Need about, oh, twenty of them at least repaired. Report to me or Jacob
npc.elliott.good_thanks_man_5: Good. Thanks, man. That's one vote you got for helping us with this. If you want to redo this task just say {abandoned sewers} to repeat it.
npc.elliott.you_already_reported_6: You already reported this mission, go to the next.
npc.elvith.do_you_want_1: Do you want to buy a poem scroll for 200 gold?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.hello_brother_you_1: Hello, brother. You come with a question to me, I believe?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.and_what_is_2: And what is it you want? Do you bring news from the undead, or do you seek a dark {artefact}?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.hello_brother_you_3: Hello, brother. You have finished the dance?
npc.emael.do_you_want_1: Do you want to appropriately show off your boss trophies and buy an additional podium of vigour for 1000000 Gold?
npc.emael.ah_i_see_2: Ah, I see you killed a lot of dangerous creatures. Here's your podium of vigour!
npc.emael.please_make_sure_3: Please make sure you have free slots in your store inbox.
npc.emael.you_have_not_5: You have not aquired enough knowledge in hunting big scary creatures.
npc.emma.i_am_still_1: I am still a bit sceptical, but well, welcome to the girls brigade.
npc.emma.how_unnecessarily_complic_2: How unnecessarily complicated, but that's the way those Thaians are. In the end we got what we wanted and they can't do anything about it.
npc.emma.i_think_the_4: I think the druids will be pleased to hear that the immediate threat has been averted.
npc.emma.bring_me_the_5: Bring me the heart as proof.
npc.emma.great_this_blow_6: Great! This blow strikes them where it hurts most: profit.
npc.emma.i_hope_our_7: I hope our craftsmen can do something with this stuff. For me it makes hardly any sense.
npc.emma.you_need_to_8: You need to bring me those plans!
npc.emma.i_will_have_9: I will have this correspondence examined by our specialists. I am sure they are quite revealing.
npc.emma.bring_me_back_10: Bring me back some hints or something!
npc.emma.i_hope_this_11: I hope this old book will do those researches any good. Personally I see little use to proof some bloodlines after we cut all ties to Thais.
npc.emma.you_need_to_12: You need to bring us that book of family trees!
npc.emma.please_bring_me_13: Please bring me proof of the mad technomancers defeat!
npc.emma.a_man_in_15: A man in the girls brigade? Come on this is hilarious, this is outright stupid, this is ... exactly what no one would expect. Mhm, on second thought the element of surprise might offset your male inferiority.
npc.emma.dont_try_to_16: Don't try to fool me. We are perfectly aware to whom you are loyal.
npc.emperor_kruzak.in_exchange_for_1: In exchange for a truly generous donation, I will offer a special outfit. Do you want to make a donation?
npc.emperor_kruzak.in_that_case_2: In that case, return to me once you made up your mind.
npc.emperor_kruzak.take_this_armor_3: Take this armor as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend!
npc.emperor_kruzak.please_make_sure_4: Please make sure you have free slots in your store inbox.
npc.emperor_kruzak.you_do_not_5: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.emperor_kruzak.take_this_helmet_7: Take this helmet as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
npc.emperor_kruzak.you_do_not_8: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.emperor_kruzak.you_need_to_10: You need to donate {armor} outfit first.
npc.emperor_kruzak.take_this_boots_11: Take this boots as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
npc.emperor_kruzak.you_do_not_12: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.emperor_kruzak.you_need_to_14: You need to donate {helmet} addon first.
npc.emperor_kruzak.so_you_wold_15: So you wold like to donate 500.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique armor?
npc.emperor_kruzak.so_you_would_16: So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear unique helmet?
npc.emperor_kruzak.so_you_would_17: So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique boots?
npc.emperor_rehal.may_fire_and_1: May Fire and Earth bless you, stranger. What leads you to Beregar, the dwarven city?
npc.emperor_rehal.i_always_liked_2: I always liked him and I still can't believe that he really stole that ring.
npc.emperor_rehal.interesting_the_fact_3: Interesting. The fact that you have the ring means that Nokmir can't have stolen it. Combined with the information Grombur gave you, the case appears in a completely different light. ...
npc.emperor_rehal.let_there_be_4: Let there be justice for all. Nokmir is innocent and acquitted from all charges! And Rerun... I want him in prison for this malicious act!
npc.emperor_rehal.hes_very_ambitious_5: He's very ambitious and always volunteers for the long shifts.
npc.emperor_rehal.as_you_have_6: As you have proven yourself trustworthy I'm going to assign you a special mission. Are you interested?
npc.emperor_rehal.my_son_was_7: My son was captured by trolls? Doesn't sound like him, but if you say so. Now you want a reward, huh? ...
npc.emperor_rehal.look_at_these_8: Look at these dwarven legs. They were forged years ago by a dwarf who was rather tall for our kind. I want you to have them. Thank you for rescuing my son |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.emperor_rehal.alright_then_come_9: Alright then, come back when you are ready.
npc.erayo.vescu_gave_you_1: Vescu gave you an assassin outfit? Haha. Noticed it lacks the head piece? You look a bit silly. Want my old head piece?
npc.erayo.good_start_with_2: Good. Start with the blue cloth. I'll wait.
npc.erayo.you_dont_have_3: You don't have the required items.
npc.eremo.a_letter_from_1: A letter from that youngster Morgan? I believed him dead since years. These news are good news indeed. Thank you very much, my friend.
npc.eroth.have_you_ever_1: Have you ever heard of Elvenbane? It is the castle west of Ab'Dendriel which is inhabited by villains from all over the continent. Any support in this war is welcome. Are you willing to help?
npc.eroth.i_heard_the_2: I heard the blow! The reflection must have caused a overcharge of magical energy leading to the contraction and the implosion. Just like I hoped! Please take this as a reward. Thank you very much.
npc.eruaran.you_can_try_1: You can try to create {sword}s, {axe}s, {club}s, {bow}s, {crossbow}s and {spellbook}s.
npc.eruaran.the_raw_object_2: The raw object is nothing but a pale of shadow of its potential. As unsafe and unpredictable the imporvement is, it might boot the powers of your item immensely. You can try to improve {sword}s, {axe}s, {club}s, {bow}s, {crossbow}s and {spellbook}s.
npc.eruaran.from_time_to_3: From time to time fate smiles upon those who take great risks and have strong dreams! If you have the {ingredients}, we can try to give the ultimate refinement to {sword}s, {axe}s, {club}s, {bow}s, {crossbow}s and {spellbook}s.

npc.eshaya.very_good_but_1: Very good. But now you need the Ring of Secret Thoughts back in order to extract the Ambassador's memories.
npc.eshaya.you_found_the_2: You found the Ring of Secret Thoughts! Well done! Now give it to the Ambassador as a present. He's a peacock and will accept such a precious gift for sure. As soon as he wears it, his memories will be stored in the ring.
npc.eshaya.im_willing_to_3: I'm willing to admit that I need help. And the help of someone who is not from {Issavi} at that. But the task could be dangerous and you would become embroiled in the politics and court intrigues of {Kilmaresh}. Will you help me anyhow?
npc.eshaya.this_is_the_4: This is the proof we need! Very well done! You have to report this to our {Empress}. She will grant you an audience now.
npc.eshaya.you_havent_completed_5: You haven't completed your mission yet. Keep searching!
npc.eshaya.i_dont_know_6: I don't know whether you are experienced in such things. If not, you could ask somebody who is. But I'm not sure where in Issavi you should look to hire a thief.
npc.eshaya.i_guess_claiming_7: I guess claiming back a present would be a bit suspicious. You'll have to find another way. I resent thinking about theft but sometimes, desperate times call for desperate measures.
npc.eshaya.you_got_the_8: You got the ring back? Very well done! Now search for the memories that will prove the Ambassador's treason. I don't know much about ancient artefacts but you could ask the librarian in the palace. I'm sure he knows something helpful.
npc.eshaya.good_luck_on_9: Good luck on your audience with the Empress. May Kilmaresh prosper.
npc.eustacio.i_am_eustacio_1: I am Eustacio. At your service.
npc.eustacio.its_just_the_2: It's just the time to make a fortune.
npc.eustacio.i_am_an_3: I am an aspiring businessman, who thrives to climb the ladder of success in the Venorean society.
npc.ezebeth.well_there_is_1: Well, there is little where we need help beyond the normal tasks you can do for the city. However, there is one thing out of the ordinary where some {assistance} would be appreciated.
npc.ezebeth.you_already_asked_2: You already asked for a mission, go to the next.
npc.ezebeth.its_nothing_really_3: It's nothing really important, so no one has yet found the time to look it up. It concerns the town's beggars that have started to behave {strange} lately.
npc.ezebeth.they_usually_know_4: They usually know better than to show up in the streets and harass our citizens, but lately they've grown more bold or desperate or whatever. I ask you to investigate what they are up to. If necessary, you may scare them away a bit.
npc.fa_hradin.whoa_a_human_1: Whoa! A human! This is no place for you, |PLAYERNAME|. Go and play somewhere else.
npc.fa_hradin.aaaah_what_have_2: Aaaah... what have we here. A human - interesting. And such an ugly specimen, too... All right, human |PLAYERNAME|. How can I help you?
npc.fa_hradin.looking_for_work_3: Looking for work, are you? Well, it's very tempting, you know, but I'm afraid we do not really employ beginners. Perhaps our cook could need a helping hand in the kitchen.
npc.fa_hradin.did_you_already_4: Did you already retrieve the spyreport?
npc.fa_hradin.did_you_already_5: Did you already talk to Gabel about the report? I think he will have further instructions for you.
npc.faloriel.so_the_librarian_1: So, the Librarian sent you. Well, yes, I have a vial of the hallucinogen you need. I'll give it to you for 1000 gold. Do you agree?
npc.faloriel.i_dont_have_2: I don't have anything to offer you regarding a ring.
npc.faloriel.you_do_not_4: You do not have enough money.
npc.farhilorn_of_the_winter_court.we_all: We allow able champions of all races to fight for our cause against the challenges of the {arena}. So are you interested? I'm not interested in fancy'wordplay, so a simple {yes} or {no} will suffice!
npc.farhilorn_of_the_winter_court.you_ar: You are now able to enter the teleport.
npc.farhilorn_of_the_winter_court.this_p: This place has always been a site where the champions of summer and winter have clashed in battle. Over the centuries this spectacle has drawn many creatures here to watch, participate and indulge in less savory activities.
npc.fenech.so_you_ask_1: So you ask me for a {
npc.fenech.what_i_have_2: What? I have already gave you one {
npc.fenech.sorry_you_arent_3: Sorry, you aren't a druid either a sorcerer.
npc.fenech.here_you_are_4: Here you are young adept, take care yourself.
npc.fenech.of_course_just_5: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at
npc.flickering_soul.it_has_been_1: It has been a while since I roamed the world of the living in a mortal shell.
npc.flickering_soul.i_had_many_2: I had many names in my live. The one that would be the most recognizable is probably the name Goshnar. Even that was an assumed name that I took when I left my mundane past behind.
npc.flickering_soul.everything_in_my_3: Everything in my life was just a tool to further my goals. The brotherhood of bones was just a tool for me. As was everyone or everything. In the path I had chosen nothing mattered but me and my ambitions.
npc.flickering_soul.necromancy_was_a_4: Necromancy was a passion at first, another tool while I amassed power and a crutch when my ambitions surpassed that what it could accomplish.
npc.flickering_soul.my_demise_did_5: My demise did not meet me unprepared. As a powerful necromancer I had fettered my soul in the living world and the realms beyond. I had prepared for my return and was confident in my power.
npc.flickering_soul.my_soul_wandered_6: My soul wandered the plains of Zarganash, waiting for my wards to power up. Waiting for my soul to be slowly pulled back and manifest in the world of the living once again. What I had not taken into consideration was peace.
npc.flickering_soul.i_recognized_the_7: I recognized the extent of my folly and failure. I decided not to return to the world of the living.
npc.flickering_soul.the_only_way_8: The only way I can get rid of them is to disperse them, to 'kill' them so to say. But they are tainted parts of myself and even going near them might endanger my sanity and stability. So all I can do is to ask you to do this daunting task.
npc.flickering_soul.im_aware_i_9: I'm aware I have no right to ask and I have little to offer as a payment, but I ask you nonetheless. Will you face my fettered vices and destroy them for me?
npc.flickering_soul.thank_you_for_10: Thank you for accepting this burden.
npc.flickering_soul.you_havent_killed_11: You haven't killed Malice yet. You haven't killed Hatred yet. You haven't killed Spite yet. You haven't killed Cruelty yet. You haven't killed Greed yet.
npc.flickering_soul.my_daughter_was_12: My daughter was as ambitious as me, yet she lacked my intellect and my raw talent. She still was great and talented yet I sadly let her feel my disdain. One of the many errors that my way of hubris made me do.
npc.flickering_soul.im_not_aware_13: I'm not aware of the fate of my linage. Neither I'm able to relate to the mortal world in that way. Each of us is an individual, not bound by ties of blood or herritage.
npc.flickering_soul.his_avatar_might_14: His avatar might be destroyed for now and it'd grip on Zarganash considerably weakened. Yet he burrowed to deep into the essence of this realm to be annihilated this easy.
npc.flickering_soul.i_despised_my_15: I despised my followers for their petty agendas and for their limited vision of my own goals and personality.
npc.flickering_soul.i_have_cleansed_16: I have cleansed you from the taints that you carried with you. You are now free from the burden that you should not have to bear.
npc.flickering_soul.you_are_not_17: You are not tainted by the darkness of the world. You are pure and free from the burdens that others carry.
npc.flora.do_you_really_1: Do you really want to enter the Glooth Fairy's hideout. There is no chickening out and I also have to charge one voting right! {Yes} or {no}?

npc.ivalisse.well_i_hope_1: Well, I hope you like it here. We tried to rebuild in the {Shaper}'s will. I am a bit preoccupied at the moment because of the absence of my {father}. I may not be the best of help currently, sorry.

npc.jack_fate_goroma.id_love_to_1: I'd love to bring you back to Liberty Bay, but as you can see, my ship is ruined. I also hurt my leg and can barely move. Can you help me?
npc.jack_fate_goroma.have_you_brought_2: Have you brought 30 pieces of wood so that I can repair the ship?

npc.jack_fate_goroma.good_please_return_: Good! Please return once you have gathered 30 pieces of wood.
npc.jack_fate_goroma.excellent_now_we_5: Excellent! Now we can leave this godforsaken place. Thank you for your help. Should you ever want to return to this island, ask me for a passage to Goroma.
npc.jack.gesundheit_are_you_1: Gesundheit! Are you alright? Did you... want to tell me something by that?
npc.jack.what_have_you_2: What have you done? What are all these pieces of furniture doing here? Those are ugly at best and - hey! Stop! Leave the wallpaper alone! Alright, alright! Just tell me, why are you doing this? Who's behind all this?
npc.jack.what_no_way_3: WHAT?? No way, I ask you again - you DID tell me the TRUTH here... right?
npc.jack.yeah_yeah_so_5: Yeah, yeah... so what are you still doing here? I guess I... will have to seek out this Spectulus now, see what he has to say. There is nothing left for me in this place.
npc.jack.i_was_sculpting_6: I... was... sculpting sulky sculptures. For all my life. Until you came in here and DESTROYED MY MASTERPIECE. Go away. I don't like you.

npc.jack_springer.here_is_your_4: Here is your first addon for your efforts!
npc.jack_springer.incredible_you_averted: Incredible! You averted a crisis that would have utterly crippled our defences aganist any other threat that is arising. Let me grant you the honor to be one of the hands of the inquisition alongside with the according outfit as a reward.
npc.jack_springer.indeed_you_averted_6: Indeed you averted us a great danger! We will ever be greatful to you hand of the inquisition!
npc.jack_springer.you_need_to_7: You need to travel to the isle of the kings and end this threat before they raise king Zelos!

npc.jacob.good_thanks_man_6: Good. Thanks, man. That's one vote you got for helping us with this.
npc.jacob.you_already_reported_7: You already reported this mission, go to the next.

npc.jamesfrancis.id_like_to_2: I'd like to work in this cave researching the minotaurs. But right now there are too many of hem and what is more, they are too powerful for me. Could you enter the cave and kill at least 50 of these creatures?
npc.jamesfrancis.great_job_you_3: Great job! You have killed at least 50 of these monsters. I give this key to you to open the door to the inner area. Go there and find out what's going on.

npc.jamesfrancis.very_nice_return_5: Very nice. Return to me if you've finished your job.

npc.julius.our_nightly_bloodsucking_1: Our nightly blood-sucking visitors put the inhabitants of Yalahar in constant danger. The worst thing is that anyone in this city could be a vampire. Maybe an outsider like you could help us. Would you try?
npc.julius.hmm_i_see_2: Hmm, I see, I see. That necklace is only a small indication though... I think I need another proof, just to make sure. Say... have you ever baked {garlic bread}?
npc.julius.i_fear_that_3: I fear that will not do. Sorry.
npc.julius.i_fear_that_4: I fear that will not do. Sorry.
npc.julius.let_me_check_5: Let me check - yes indeed, there's garlic in it. Now eat one, in front of my eyes. Right now! Say '{aaah}' when you've chewed it all down so that I can see you're not hiding it!
npc.julius.so_are_you_6: So, are you ready for your first real task?
npc.julius.are_you_back_7: Are you back with confirmed names of possible vampires?
npc.julius.oh_you_look_8: Oh! You look horrible - I mean, rather weary. What happened? Who is the master vampire?
npc.julius.well_theres_one_9: Well, there's one problem. How would I know I can trust you? You might be one of them... hm. Can you think of something really unlikely for a vampire? If you know a way to prove it to me, ask me about your {mission}.
npc.julius.fine_then_talk_10: Fine then. Talk to me again about your mission once you have the garlic bread. You can get holy water from a member of the inquisition.
npc.julius.fine_good_luck_11: Fine. Good luck! Talk to me again about your mission once you have confirmed the names of five suspects.
npc.julius.alright_wait_a_12: Alright, wait a moment. Tell me one name at a time so I can note them down carefully. Who is a suspect?
npc.julius.well_you_need_13: Well, you need to mix flour with holy water and use that dough on garlic to create a special dough. Bake it like normal bread, but I guarantee that no vampire can eat that. Are you following me?
npc.julius.i_guess_armenius_14: I guess Armenius, Lisander, Maris, Ortheus and Serafin are all the names we can get for now. Let me think for a moment what we are going to do, talk to me about your mission again later.
npc.julius.no_no_i_15: No, no, I was asking for one of the names.
npc.julius.very_well_i_16: Very well. I think I can trust you now. Sorry that I had to put you through this embarassing procedure, but I'm sure you understand. So, are you ready for your first real task?
npc.julius.no_no_you_17: No, no, you didn't eat it! Vampire Brood! Say '{aaah}' once you have eaten the bread or get out of her instantly!
npc.julius.he_really_doesnt_18: He really doesn't look like the man of the sea he pretends to be, does he? Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.you_already_reported_19: You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.hm_you_dont_20: Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.i_always_thought_21: I always thought that there is not really a poor beggar hidden under those ragged clothes. Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.you_already_reported_22: You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.hm_you_dont_23: Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.nice_angelic_name_24: Nice angelic name for a vampire. But he didn't escape your attention, well done. Noted down! Any other name?

npc.julius.hm_you_dont_26: Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?
npc.julius.yes_that_pale_27: Yes, that pale skin and those black eyes speak volumes. Noted down! Any other name?
npc.julius.you_already_reported_28: You already reported that name. Any new ones?
npc.julius.hm_you_dont_29: Hm. You don't look so sure about that one. You should not report suspects that you did not confirm yourself! Any others?

npc.julius.i_see_so_36: I see... so Armenius is the master, and the spell didn't even cause a scratch on him... Well, that went worse than expected. Let me think for a moment and then ask me about a mission again.
npc.karith.whats_that_bug_1: What's that? Bug milk? Hm, perhaps I can find some customers for that!
npc.karith.sand_wasp_honey_2: Sand wasp honey? Hm, interesting at least!
npc.karith.some_special_spice_3: Some special spice might be of value indeed.
npc.karith.i_can_hardly_4: I can hardly imagine that someone is interested in embalming fluid, but I'll give it a try.
npc.karith.of_course_ivory_5: Of course! Ivory! Its value is quite obvious.
npc.karith.this_royal_satin_6: This royal satin is indeed of acceptable quality.
npc.karith.i_doubt_that_7: I doubt that the esteemed Yalahari will indulge into something profane as rum. But who knows, I'll give it a try.
npc.karith.i_doubt_that_8: I doubt that these flowers will stay fresh and healthy forever. But if they do, they could be indeed valuable.
npc.karl.do_you_bring_1: Do you bring me a barrel of beer??
npc.karl.do_you_want_2: Do you want to buy a bottle of our finest whisper beer for 80 gold?
npc.karl.you_dont_have_4: You don't have any barrel of beer!
npc.karl.here_dont_take_5: Here. Don't take it into the city though.
npc.kazzan.feel_welcome_in_2: Feel welcome in the lands of the children of the enlightened Daraman, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.kazzan.do_you_know_3: Do you know the location of the djinn fortresses in the mountains south of here?
npc.kazzan.well_i_dont_4: Well, I don't blame you for that. I am sure you did your best. Now we can just hope that peace remains. Here, take this small gratification for your effort to help and Daraman may bless you!
npc.kevin.you_are_not_1: You are not a member of our guild yet! We have high standards for our members. To rise in our guild is a difficult but rewarding task. Are you interested in joining?
npc.kevin.so_you_have_2: So you have finally made it! I did not think that you would have it in you ... However: are you ready for another assignment?
npc.kevin.excellent_you_got_3: Excellent, you got it fixed! This will teach this mailbox a lesson indeed! Are you interested in another assignment?
npc.kevin.you_truly_got_4: You truly got him? Quite impressive. You are a very promising candidate! I think I have another mission for you. Are you interested?
npc.kevin.do_you_bring_5: Do you bring all bones for our officers' safety fund at once?
npc.kevin.splendid_i_knew_6: Splendid, I knew we could trust you. I would like to ask for your help in another matter. Are you interested?
npc.kevin.once_more_you_7: Once more you have impressed me! Are you willing to do another job?
npc.kevin.first_you_need_8: First you need to complete your current mission.
npc.kevin.excellent_another_job_9: Excellent! Another job well done! Would you accept another mission?

npc.kevin.you_did_it_12: You did it? I hope you did not catch a flu in the cold! Anyway, there's another mission for you. Are you interested?

npc.kevin.hm_i_might_34: Hm, I might consider your proposal, but first you will have to prove your worth by doing some tasks for us. Are you willing to do that?
npc.kevin.excellent_your_first_35: Excellent! Your first task will be quite simple. But you should better write my instructions down anyways. You can read and write?
npc.kevin.so_listen_you_36: So listen, you will check certain tours our members have to take to see if there is some trouble. First travel with Captain Bluebear's ship from Thais to Carlin, understood?
npc.kevin.excellent_once_you_37: Excellent! Once you have done that you will travel with Uzon to Edron. You will find him in the Femor Hills. Understood?
npc.kevin.fine_fine_next_38: Fine, fine! Next, travel with Captain Seahorse to the city of Venore. Understood?
npc.kevin.good_finally_find_39: Good! Finally, find the technomancer Brodrosch and travel with him to the Isle of Cormaya. After this passage report back to me here. Understood?
npc.kevin.ok_remember_the_40: Ok, remember: the Tibian mail service puts trust in you! Don't fail and report back soon. Just tell me about your {mission}.
npc.kevin.i_am_glad_41: I am glad to hear that. One of our mailboxes was reported to be jammed. It is located on the so called 'mountain' on theisle Folda. Get a crowbar and fix the mailbox. Report about your mission when you have done so.
npc.kevin.for_your_noble_42: For your noble deeds I grant you the title Assistant Postofficer. All Postofficers will charge you less money from now on. After every second mission ask me for an ADVANCEMENT. Your next task will be a bit more challenging. Do you feel ready for it?
npc.kevin.i_need_you_43: I need you to deliver a bill to the stage magician David Brassacres. He's hiding from his creditors somewhere in Venore. It's likely you will have to trick him somehow to reveal his identity. Report back when you delivered this bill.
npc.kevin.ok_listen_we_44: Ok, listen: we have some serious trouble with agressive dogs lately. We have accumulated some bones as a sort of pacifier but we need more. Collect 20 bones like the one in my room to the left and report here.
npc.kevin.you_have_collected_45: You have collected all the 20 bones needed. Excellent! Now let's talk about further missions if you are interested.
npc.kevin.i_grant_you_47: I grant you the title of postman. You are now a full member of our guild. Here have your own officers hat and wear it with pride.
npc.kevin.since_i_am_48: Since I am convinced I can trust you, this time you must deliver a valuable present to Dermot on Fibula. Do NOT open it!!! You will find the present behind the door here on the lower right side of this room.
npc.kevin.ok_we_need_49: Ok. We need a new set of uniforms, and only the best will do for us. Please travel to Venore and negotiate with Hugo Chief acontract for new uniforms.
npc.kevin.good_go_there_50: Good. Go there and find out what taste he dislikes most: mouldy cheese, a piece of fur or abananaskin. Tell him to SNIFF, then the object. Show him the object and ask 'Do you like that?'.DONT let the guards know what you are doing.
npc.kevin.good_so_listen_51: Good, so listen. Hugo Chief informed me that he needs the measurements of our postofficers. Go and bring me the measurements of Ben, Lokur, Dove, Liane, Chrystal and Olrik.
npc.kevin.from_now_on_52: From now on it shall be known that you are a grand postman. You are now a privilegedmember until the end of days. Most captains around the world have an agreement with our guild to transport our privileged members, like you, for less gold.
npc.kevin.ok_but_your_53: Ok but your next assignment might be dangerous. Our Courier Waldo has been missing for a while. I must assume he is dead. Can you follow me so far?
npc.kevin.find_out_about_54: Find out about his whereabouts and retrieve him or at least his posthorn. He was looking for a new underground passage that is rumoured to be found underneath the troll-infested Mountain east of Thais.
npc.kevin.thank_you_we_55: Thank you. We will honour this. Your next mission will be a very special one. Good thing you are a special person as well. Are you ready?
npc.kevin.from_now_on_56: From now on you are a grand postman for special operations. You are an honoured member of our guild and earned the privilege of your own post horn. Here, take it.
npc.kevin.so_listen_well_57: So listen well. Behind the lower left door you will find a bag. The letters in the bag are for none other than Santa Claus! Deliver them to his house on the isle of Vega, {use} thebag on his mailbox and report back here.
npc.kevin.excellent_here_is_58: Excellent. Here is a letter for you to deliver. Well, to be honest, no one else volunteered. It's a letter from the mother of Markwin, the king of Mintwallin. Deliver that letter to him, but note that you will not be welcome there.
npc.kevin.i_grant_you_59: I grant you the title of Archpostman. You are a legend in our guild. As privilege of your newly aquired status you are allowed to make use of certain mailboxes in dangerous areas. Just look out for them and you'll see.

npc.maeryn.so_you_dont_1: So you don't know it yet. This island, Grimvale, is affected by were-sickness. Many {pitiful}, who are stricken with the curse, dwell in the {tunnels} and caverns underneath the village and the nearby hurst.
npc.maeryn.yes_pitiful_for_2: Yes, pitiful. For they are savage beasts now who regularly come up from below to attack the village. But once they were inhabitants of Grimvale, before they {changed}.
npc.maeryn.through_a_bite_3: Through a bite or even a scratch, you may be infected with the were-sickness. If that happens, there is little {hope} - until the next full moon you'll change into a were-creature, depending on the animal that hurt you.
npc.maeryn.there_is_a_4: There is a plant, the purple nightshade. It blossoms exclusively in the light of the full moon and only underground, where the full moon's light is falling through fissures in the surface. Only this plant's blossoms are able to defeat the {were-sickness}.
npc.maeryn.yes_the_story_5: Yes, the story goes that there are ancient artefacts still hidden in the temple ruins, such as helmets in the form of wolven heads, for example. It is said that moonlight crystals are needed to enchant these artefacts.
npc.maeryn.three_of_these_6: Three of these blossoms should suffice to heal some afflicted persons. But if you bring more I'd be grateful, of course.
npc.maeryn.im_the_protector_10: I'm the protector of this little village. A bit of a self-proclaimed function, I admit, but someone has to watch over {Grimvale}. It is a {dangerous} place.
npc.maeryn.the_small_island_11: The small island you are standing on. For a long time it was a peaceful and placid place. But lately it has become more {dangerous}.
npc.maeryn.hes_an_experienced_12: He's an experienced hunter and knows much about the woods, the animals that dwell there, and about the {werewolves}. He's devoted himself to finding out everything there is to know about the {Curse}.
npc.maeryn.yes_my_friend_13: Yes, my friend, werewolves. They dwell here on {Grimvale}, threatening our life. The were-sickness transforms peaceful villagers into savage beasts. We're not sure how this curse found its way into our small village. But undoubtedly it did.
npc.maeryn.shes_an_old_14: She's an old druid. She's been living here on {Grimvale} since she was a little girl, just like me. She's very interested in were-creature body parts. If you find any, I'm sure she will love to trade with you.
npc.maeryn.hes_basically_a_15: He's basically a ferryman nowadays, but I remember when he was our village's leading fisherman. He offers a ferry service between Grimvale and Edron. You must have met him - he sailed you here.
npc.maeryn.you_brought_the_16: You brought the wolven helmet, as i see. Do you want to change something?
npc.maeryn.so_which_profession_17: So, which profession would you give preference to when enchanting the helmet: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {druid} or {paladin}?
npc.maeryn.and_what_would_18: And what would be your preferred weapon? {Club}, {axe} or {sword}
npc.maeryn.so_this_is_19: So this is your choice. If you want to change it, you will have to come to me again.

npc.mortimer.you_really_got_42: You really got it? Amazing! Thank you for your efforts.

npc.sandra.would_you_like_2: Would you like to get a lottery ticket instead of the deposit for your vials?
npc.sandra.are_you_here_3: Are you here to claim a prize?
npc.sandra.pssht_not_that_4: Pssht, not that loud. So they have sent you to get... the stuff?
npc.sandra.what_how_dare_5: What?? How dare you?! I am a sorcerer of the most reknown academy on the face of this world. Do you think some lousy pirates could scare me? Get lost! Now! I will have no further dealings with the likes of you!
npc.sandra.great_ive_signed_6: Great! I've signed you up for our bonus system. From now on, you will have the chance to win the potion belt addon!
npc.sandra.alright_thank_you_7: Alright, thank you very much! Here is your lottery ticket, good luck. Would you like to deposit more vials that way?
npc.sandra.sorry_but_you_8: Sorry, but you don't have 100 empty flasks or vials of the SAME kind and thus don't qualify for the lottery. Would you like to deposit the vials you have as usual and receive 5 gold per vial?
npc.sandra.congratulations_here_from_9: Congratulations! Here, from now on you can wear our lovely potion belt as accessory.
npc.sandra.sorry_but_you_10: Sorry, but you don't have your lottery ticket with you.
npc.sandra.finally_you_have_11: Finally. You have no idea how difficult it is to keep something secret here. And you brought me all the crystal coins I demanded?
npc.santiago.oh_whats_wrong_1: Oh, what's wrong? As I said, simply go to my house south of here and go upstairs. Then come back and we'll continue our chat.
npc.santiago.ive_forgotten_to_2: I've forgotten to tell you something. Of course I need proof that you killed cockroaches. Please bring me at least 3 of their legs. Good luck!
npc.santiago.ive_forgotten_to_3: I've forgotten to tell you something. Of course I need proof that you killed cockroaches. Please bring me at least 3 of their legs. Good luck!
npc.santiago.great_please_go_4: Great, please go to my house, just a few steps south of here. Upstairs in my room, you'll find a chest. You can keep what you find inside of it! Come back after you got it and greet me to talk to me again. {Yes}?
npc.santiago.alright_do_you_5: Alright! Do you see the button called 'Quest Log'? There you can check the status of quests, like this one. {Bye} for now!
npc.santiago.ah_no_need_6: Ah, no need to say anything, I can see it suits you perfectly. Now we're getting to the fun part, let's get you armed! Are you ready for some {action}?
npc.santiago.oh_you_dont_7: Oh, you don't wear it properly yet. You need to drag and drop it from your bag to your armor slot. Here, let me show you again. Is it a little {clearer} now?
npc.santiago.oh_no_did_8: Oh no, did you lose my coat? Well, lucky you, I have a spare one here. Don't lose it again! Now we're getting to the fun part, let's get you armed! Are you ready for some {action}?
npc.santiago.i_knew_i_9: I knew I could count on you. Here, take this good and sturdy weapon in your hand. Then go back to my house and down the ladder. Good luck, and {bye} for now!
npc.santiago.thats_just_great_10: That's just great! Now you have more health points, can carry more stuff and walk faster. Talking about health, did you get {hurt} by those cockroaches?
npc.santiago.really_you_look_11: Really? You look fine to me, must have been just a scratch. Well, there are much more dangerous monsters than cockroaches out there. Take a look at your status bar. You have 155 Health right now. I'll show you something, {yes}?
npc.santiago.this_is_an_12: This is an important lesson from me - an experienced veteran fighter. Take this! Look at your status bar again. As you can see, you've lost health. Now I'll tell you how to heal that, {yes}?
npc.santiago.i_knew_youd_13: I knew you'd get it right away. You can loot food from many creatures, such as deer and rabbits. You can find them in the forest nearby. By the way... have you seen {Zirella}?
npc.santiago.really_she_was_14: Really?? She was looking for someone to help her. Maybe you could go and see her. She lives just to the east and down the mountain. So, thank you again and {bye} for now!
npc.santiago.this_is_an_15: This is an important lesson from me - an experienced veteran fighter. Take this! Look at your status bar again. As you can see, you've lost health. Now I'll tell you how to heal that, {yes}?
npc.santiago.i_knew_i_16: I knew I could count on you. Here, take this good and sturdy weapon in your hand. Then go back to my house and down the ladder. Good luck, and {bye} for now!
npc.santiago.i_knew_youd_17: I knew you'd get it right away. You can loot food from many creatures, such as deer and rabbits. You can find them in the forest nearby. By the way... have you seen {Zirella}?
npc.sarina.do_you_want_1: Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.sebastian.do_you_want_1: Do you want to sail Nargor for 50 gold coins?
npc.serafin.oh_no_i_1: Oh, no I don't sell cookies. Or, do you mean you'd like to give me one?
npc.serafin.itd_be_better_2: It'd be better for you to leave now.
npc.serafin.cough_what_kind_3: COUGH?! What kind of a mean trick is that? Get out of my shop!
npc.servant_sentry.the_slime_has_1: The. {Slime}. Has. Entered. Our. {Master}. Has. Left! We. Must. {Help}.
npc.servant_sentry.defeat_slime_we_2: Defeat. {Slime}. We. Will. Why. Did. You. Kill. Us? Do. You. Want. To. Rectify. And. Help?
npc.servant_sentry.then_take_this_3: Then. Take. This. Gobbler. Always. Hungry. Eats. Slime. Fungus. Go.
npc.seymour.hmmm_let_me_1: Hmmm, let me look at you. You got that intelligent sparkle in your eyes and you'd love to handle great power - that must be a future sorcerer!
npc.seymour.hmmm_let_me_2: Hmmm, let me look at you. You have an aura of great wisdom and may have healing hands as well as a sense for the powers of nature - I think you're a natural born druid!
npc.seymour.hmmm_let_me_3: Hmmm, let me look at you. <missing message, destiny for paladin>!
npc.seymour.hmmm_let_me_4: Hmmm, let me look at you. Strong and sturdy, with a determined look in your eyes - no doubt the knight profession would be suited for you!
npc.shauna.what_do_you_1: What do you think? I am the sheriff of Carlin.
npc.shiantis.do_you_want_1: Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.shiriel.of_course_just_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at
npc.shirith.do_you_want_1: Do you want to buy a key for 50 gold?
npc.shirtalis_of_the_summer_court.we_all: We allow able champions of all races to fight for our cause against the challenges of the {arena}. So are you interested? I'm not interested in fancy'wordplay, so a simple {yes} or {no} will suffice!
npc.shirtalis_of_the_summer_court.you_ar: You are now able to enter the teleport.
npc.shirtalis_of_the_summer_court.this_p: This place has always been a site where the champions of summer and winter have clashed in battle. Over the centuries this spectacle has drawn many creatures here to watch, participate and indulge in less savory activities.
npc.shoddy_beggar.hmm_if_you_1: Hmm, if you can spare a coin... we can talk. What do you say?
npc.shoddy_beggar.persistent_little_nuis: Persistent little nuisance, aren't we? Well, I like your spirit so I will tell you a secret. I may not look the part but I was once a {scientist}. The academy seemed to not like my... attitude and never actually invited me.
npc.shoddy_beggar.indeed_i_was_3: Indeed, I was one myself a long time ago. I may seem a little... distracted by now, but I was working on many important projects. I even created a device to... well, it will cost you another gold coin if you want me to tell you the whole story. You're in?
npc.shoddy_beggar.well_if_that_4: Well, if that is all you can spare... better keep it.
npc.shoddy_beggar.alright_it_seems_5: Alright, it seems you are serious about this. I will tell you about my device. Every night I looked up to the stars and wondered what worlds we would be able to find if we could just look where we wanted to. So... hey are you still listening?
npc.shoddy_beggar.good_good_so_6: Good, good. So eventually I found a way and invented a magic device I called the Lightboat. It was a large construction you could sit in and... well, judging by your looks you don't believe a word. Do you want to hear the story or not?
npc.shoddy_beggar.fine_for_years_7: Fine. For years I gathered all the necessary items to build the device. I travelled, traded and took advantage of some rare opportunities. With luck and patience I eventually got every component I needed. Can you imagine the excitement I experienced?
npc.shoddy_beggar.and_there_i_8: And there I stood before my greatest invention. Door to unknown places, mysterious worlds... yet one of my components was flawed. A small crack in a vital element of my construction quickly led to the failure of the whole project. Still following?
npc.shoddy_beggar.the_device_was_9: The device was ultimately destroyed. I barely escaped the chaos with my life. My laboratory was shattered, as were all the components of the cursed device. With nothing left, I started to lead a new, different life. Do you know what that means?
npc.shoddy_beggar.pah_you_have_10: Pah!! You have NO idea, leave me alone now.
npc.shoddy_beggar.right_im_glad_11: Right... I'm glad everything was destroyed. I don't even know why I kept the remaining copy of the plans all those years... oh, did I say this aloud?
npc.shoddy_beggar.yes_well_i_12: Yes, well... I do have one remaining copy of the plans. I will keep them as a... reminder. Such ill-fated devices only cause trouble and despair. Mankind would be better off, without them, right?
npc.shoddy_beggar.ah_you_think_13: Ah, you think you are wise but you know nothing, nothing about science, nothing about the opportunities it offers... You will never understand scientists like me.
npc.shoddy_beggar.well_to_be_14: Well, to be honest, I envy him a little. He can continue his research in his laboratory. He still has working equipment... I sometimes read his publications. He is an able man, but completely on the wrong track... give these plans to him.
npc.shoddy_beggar.mean_heartless_go_15: Mean, heartless... go and leave me be.
npc.shoddy_beggar.yes_and_i_19: Yes and I, I... you mean what? Can't imagine? Well, then there is no purpose to continue telling you this story.
npc.shoddy_beggar.thought_so_it_20: Thought so. It means starting anew, without any home, money or goal in your life. However, it also opens up opportunities... don't you agree?
npc.shoddy_beggar.no_no_you_21: No, no, you are right, I should have tried to rebuild it, I should have been more careful, I should... ah, why did I even tell you this.
npc.shoddy_beggar.phew_alright_it_22: Phew... alright, it was nice talking to you.
npc.shoddy_beggar.hm_maybe_you_23: Hm, maybe you are right. You could give these plans to someone who might be able to finish this project. Someone who will not make the mistakes I made. Someone... hm, do you know the astronomer Spectulus?
npc.sholley.already_clicked_the_1: Already clicked the body on the house Roswitha ?
npc.siflind.i_heard_you_1: I heard you have already helped our cause. Are you interested in another mission, even when it requires you to travel to a distant land?
npc.siflind.well_done_the_2: Well done. The termites caused just the distraction that we needed. Are you ready for the next step of my plan?
npc.siflind.you_saved_the_3: You saved the lives of many innocent animals. Thank you very much. If you are looking for another mission, just ask me.
npc.siflind.our_warriors_need_4: Our warriors need a more potent yet more secure berserker elixir to fight our enemies. To brew it, I need several ingredients. The first things needed are 5 bat wings. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.do_you_have_5: Do you have the 5 bat wings I requested?
npc.siflind.the_second_things_6: The second things needed are 4 bear paws. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.do_you_have_7: Do you have the 4 bear paws I requested?
npc.siflind.the_next_things_8: The next things needed are 3 bonelord eyes. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.do_you_have_9: Do you have the 3 bonelord eyes I requested?
npc.siflind.the_next_things_10: The next things needed are 2 fish fins. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.do_you_have_11: Do you have the 2 fish fins I requested?
npc.siflind.the_last_thing_12: The last thing needed is a green dragon scale. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.do_you_have_13: Do you have the green dragon scale I requested?
npc.siflind.i_have_now_14: I have now no mission for you.
npc.siflind.do_you_want_15: Do you want to buy a jug for 1000 gold?
npc.siflind.good_now_listen_17: Good! Now listen. To protect the animals there, we have to harm the profit of the hunters. Therefor, I ask you to ruin their best source of earnings. Are you willing to do that?
npc.siflind.so_lets_proceed_18: So let's proceed. Take this vial of paint. Travel to Tyrsung again and ruin as many pelts of baby seals as possible before the paint runs dry or freezes. Then return here to report about your mission.
npc.siflind.thank_you_very_27: Thank you very much. This will help us to defend Svargrond. But I heard young Nilsor is in dire need of help. Please contact him immediately.
npc.siflind.you_want_to_29: You want to buy animal cure for 400 gold coins?
npc.siflind.you_dont_have_32: You dont have enough of gold coins.
npc.sigurd.of_course_just_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at
npc.simon_the_beggar.haha_that_beard_1: Haha, that beard is - well, not fake, but there's a trick behind it. I noticed people tend to be more generous towards a poor gramps. Want to know my trick?
npc.simon_the_beggar.have_you_brought_2: Have you brought me the 100 pieces of ape fur and 20000 gold pieces?
npc.simon_the_beggar.hmm_im_not_3: Hmm, I'm not done yet with your potion. But here, let me sprinkle a few drops of my own potion on your face... there you go. Now you just have to wait.
npc.simon_the_beggar.aha_i_can_4: Aha! I can see it! Now that you've waited patiently without shaving, your beard is perfect! All thanks to my, err, potion. Yes. Goodbye!
npc.simon_the_beggar.hmm_it_seems_5: Hmm, it seems you need to wait a bit longer for the potion to take full effect. Please be patient.
npc.simon_the_beggar.aha_i_can_6: Aha! I can see it! Now that you've waited patiently without shaving, your beard is perfect! All thanks to my, err, potion. Yes. Goodbye!
npc.simon_the_beggar.hmm_it_seems_7: Hmm, it seems you need to wait a bit longer for the potion to take full effect. Please be patient.
npc.simon_the_beggar.oh_im_sorry_8: Oh, I'm sorry... I almost forgot! Okay, okay... here is your promised dress. I'm sure it will look so much better on you than on me- I mean, my, err, sister.
npc.simon_the_beggar.great_come_back_9: Great! Come back to me once you have the 100 pieces of ape fur and I'll do my part of the deal.
npc.simon_the_beggar.ahh_very_good_10: Ahh! Very good. I will start mixing the potion immediately. Come back later. Bye bye.
npc.simon_the_beggar.you_do_not_11: You do not have all the required items.
npc.simon_the_beggar.you_do_not_12: You do not have all the required items.
npc.simon_the_beggar.it_seems_you_13: It seems you already have this addon, don't you try to mock me son!
npc.simon_the_beggar.no_no_our_14: No, no. Our deal is finished, no complaining now, I don't have time all day. And no, you can't have my staff.
npc.simon_the_beggar.i_said_no_15: I said, no! Or well - I have a suggestion to make. Will you listen?
npc.simon_the_beggar.good_come_back_16: Good! Come back to me once you have retrieved my staff. Good luck.
npc.simon_the_beggar.did_you_bring_17: Did you bring my favourite staff??
npc.simon_the_beggar.yes_thats_it_18: Yes!! That's it! I'm so glad! Here, you can have my other one. Thanks!
npc.simon_the_beggar.you_do_not_19: You do not have the staff.
npc.simon_the_beggar.you_do_not_20: You do not have the staff.
npc.simon_the_beggar.sorry_but_you_21: Sorry, but you need to have a premium account!
npc.simon_the_beggar.have_you_brought_22: Have you brought a cookie for the poor?
npc.simon_the_beggar.i_need_gold_23: I need gold. Can you spare 100 gold pieces for me?
npc.simon_the_beggar.you_have_no_24: You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.simon_the_beggar.you_havent_got_25: You haven't got enough money for me.
npc.simon_the_beggar.thank_you_very_26: Thank you very much. Can you spare 500 more gold pieces for me? I will give you a nice hint.
npc.simon_the_beggar.pah_i_said_28: Pah! I said 200 gold. You don't have that much.
npc.simon_the_beggar.now_you_own_29: Now you own the hot key.
npc.sinatuki.jinuma_suvituka_siq_1: Jinuma, suvituka siq chuqua!! Nguraka, nguraka! <happily takes the food from you and gives you five glimmering crystals>
npc.sinatuki.jinuma_suvituka_siq_2: Jinuma, suvituka siq chuqua!! Nguraka, nguraka! <happily takes the food from you>
npc.sinclair.so_did_you_1: So, did you find anything worth examining? Did you actually catch a ghost?
npc.sinclair.talk_research_with_3: Talk research with spectulus to take some mission.
npc.sinclair.good_now_all_4: Good, now all you need to do is find a ghost, defeat it and catch its very essence with the cage. Once you have it, return to me and Spectulus and I will move it into our chamber device. Good luck, return to me as soon as you are prepared.
npc.sinclair.go_and_use_5: Go and use the machine in a dead ghost!
npc.sinclair.good_of_course_6: Good, of course you will also receive an additional monetary reward for your troubles. Are you fine with that?
npc.sinclair.alright_let_us_7: Alright, let us see how many ghosts you caught!
npc.sinclair.you_didnt_catch_8: You didnt catch the ghost pieces.
npc.sinclair.alright_you_found_9: Alright you found something! Are you really finished hunting out there?
npc.sister_of_jack.why_are_you_1: Why are you asking, he didn't get himself into something again did he?
npc.sister_of_jack.spelltolust_that_soun: Spelltolust?! That sounds awfully nasty! What was he doing there - are you telling me he lived an alternate life and he didn't even tell {mother}?
npc.sister_of_jack.what_and_what_3: What?! And what did he do there? Who did he visit there?
npc.skjaar.i_will_give_1: I will give the key to the crypt only to the closest followers of my master. Would you like me to test you?
npc.skjaar.before_we_start_2: Before we start I must ask you for a small donation of 1000 gold coins. Are you willing to pay 1000 gold coins for the test?
npc.skjaar.all_right_then_3: All right then. Here comes the first question. What was the name of Dago's favourite pet?
npc.skjaar.perhaps_you_knew_5: Perhaps you knew him after all. Tell me - how many fingers did he have when he died?
npc.skjaar.also_true_but_6: Also true. But can you also tell me the colour of the deamons in which master specialized?
npc.skjaar.it_seems_you_7: It seems you are worthy after all. Do you want the key to the crypt?
npc.snake_eye.so_youre_the_1: So you're the delivery boy? Go ahead, but I warn you, it's quite heavy. You can take it from the box over there.
npc.snake_eye.funny_thing_that_2: Funny thing that everyone thinks we have forgers for fake documents here. But no, we don't. The best forger is old Ahmet in Ankrahmun.
npc.spectulus.you_are_back_1: You are back, how did the measurements go? Did you recognise anything of interest?
npc.spectulus.alright_you_look_2: Alright, you look bright enough to fulfil my requests - at least you do not fall asleep while standing there. Ahem... I heard about a certain inventor who created a {magic device} to actually sail the {sea of light}. Will you help me find him?
npc.spectulus.you_should_find_3: You should find the beggar somewhere in Edron. Stay persistent, I'm sure he knows more than he wants to tell us.
npc.spectulus.o_have_you_4: o have you talked to the beggar? What did he tell you? Where are the plans...? Wh...? He did? He is?  You've already got the plans? Beautiful!! Amazing! Alright it will take some time to recapitulate these plans.
npc.spectulus.so_have_you_5: So have you talked to the beggar? What did he tell you? Where are the plans...? Wh...? He did? He is? You've already got the plans? Beautiful!! Amazing! Alright it will take some time to recapitulate these plans.
npc.spectulus.it_will_take_6: It will take some time to work out the initial problem of the device. Come back when I've found the component needed to finish it. Alright, B connects to D and another two nails marked with S go... hmmm.
npc.spectulus.connects_to_n_7: ...connects to N942. Alright!! That's it! I just finished a prototype device! And it looks like I figured out the initial failure. A very special crystal is needed for the device to work. Aren't you as curious as me to know what went wrong?
npc.spectulus.did_you_enter_8: Did you enter the Lost Mines yet? They are west of Edron, close to the sea. You will also need a pick once you get to the crystal deposit.
npc.spectulus.hm_so_did_9: Hm, so did you find a rare crystal? Show me... hey! That's not a rare crystal. What... where did you get that anyway? Please return to me with the right crystal.
npc.spectulus.well_the_only_10: Well, the only thing left to do would be to offer the crystal at the well of the collector. There must be a pedestal near the well, where you need to put your donation. Ha, do you think you could do that?
npc.spectulus.found_the_well_11: Found the well yet? Look on one of the ice isles near Carlin. I'm perfectly sure that the well with the pedestal is located on one of them. And be careful with the carrying device, I only have this one prototype.
npc.spectulus.so_have_you_12: So have you found the well and entered the lair? I hope you can find the {mirror crystal} in there. It is the only way to finish the {Lightboat}.
npc.spectulus.put_the_mirror_13: Put the mirror crystal into the special carrying device I gave you and bring it directly to me.
npc.spectulus.do_you_have_14: Do you have the mirror crystal? Unbelievable! Alright I will extract the crystal from the device myself, would you please give me the device with the crystal and step back?
npc.spectulus.after_the_debacle_15: After the debacle with the crystal, I started focussing on other things. There are also some {tasks} that still need to be done. If you can spare the time to continue helping me, it shall not be to your disadvantage. So are you in for another mission?
npc.spectulus.so_you_found_16: So you found him? Have you talked to {Jack} yet?
npc.spectulus.youre_back_from_17: You're back from {Jack}! Mh, by the looks of your face I doubt our little redecoration project yielded any success. But I had an even better idea while you were gone - ready to give it another try?
npc.spectulus.so_did_you_18: So, did you talk to his family? Were you able to convince them?
npc.spectulus.did_you_find_19: Did you find out what hobby {Jack} has? Did you separate him from this activity? Only if he has a free mind, he can truly get back to his former self! Now all you need to do is talk to him again!
npc.spectulus.the_device_needs_20: The device needs a special crystal. It's called {mirror crystal}. The inventor somehow damaged it - with fatal results. He had to give up, as no second crystal was left to try. I, however, know of another one... but are you up to the task?
npc.spectulus.one_remaining_mirror_21: One remaining mirror crystal is in the hands of a creature called the collector which collects all kinds of crystals. The only way to get access to its lair is to donate a very rare crystal to a secret well. I need you to get one, will you help me?
npc.spectulus.good_because_if_22: Good, because if you wouldn't do it... listen, this well is on one of the isles near Carlin. There you offer the crystal. Once you get access to its lair, find the collector and... convince it to give you the mirror crystal. Understood?
npc.spectulus.to_collect_the_23: To collect the unbelievably rare, practically unique mirror crystal, you will need to use this special carrying device I developed. If you find the crystal, use it to store it and transport it safely to me. There is no second one.
npc.spectulus.of_course_you_24: Of course you are. And here we go. I have to ask some questions first. One: You aint afraid of no ghost, right?
npc.spectulus.good_two_you_25: Good. Two: You know that ghosts exist and/or have found and/or defeated one or more of them?
npc.spectulus.good_take_this_26: Good. Take this wand - we call it a spirit meter - and go to the graveyard I have marked on your map and take a few measurements on the graves.
npc.spectulus.let_me_see_27: Let me see the spirit meter. Hmmm... those are grave news you bring - uhm, you know what I mean. But this is awesome! Now I know for sure that the calibration is only some short bursts of magically enhanced energy away.
npc.spectulus.yes_and_he_28: Yes? And he didn't remember anything? Not even me? That's not good. Then we will have to do everything ourselves. Are you ready to continue?
npc.spectulus.ah_well_lets_29: Ah well, let's forget about the scientific details - you will do just fine as long as you do exactly what I say. Ready for me to go on with your task?
npc.spectulus.yes_maybe_it_30: Yes, maybe it was the right decision. Astronomical research is nothing for the faint-hearted.
npc.spectulus.well_the_what_31: Well, the... what? You... mean you're no longer interested? I see, well maybe I overestimated your spirit after all.
npc.spectulus.alright_alright_youll_32: Alright, alright. You'll never find out the true secrets of life with such attitude, hm.
npc.spectulus.come_on_this_33: Come on, this is our only chance to finish the Lightboat.
